Faq.title: Questions we get before we start
Faq.whatsappLink: Another question? Message us on WhatsApp

items.a: From US$500 setup, then US$150 per month for one automation. Your exact quote is set after the free audit, before any commitment.

items.q: What if the AI gets it wrong or makes something up?
items.a: The assistant only answers from the information you give us: prices, hours, terms. If it doesn’t know, it says so and passes the conversation to your team. You approve the tone and answers before anything goes live.

items.q: Do I need any technical knowledge?
items.a: None. You tell us how you work; we handle everything technical and hand over a system that just runs, with simple documentation.

items.q: Will it work with the tools I already use?
items.a: Almost always: WhatsApp, email, spreadsheets, CRM, calendar, online store, accounting software. You don’t need to switch anything.
A few days for a simple automation, a few weeks for a larger system. The timeline is in your quote, and we deliver in stages.
We can host everything on your own servers or a private instance. Credentials are stored securely and every access is limited to the strict minimum.
If a step fails, it’s retried. If it fails again, we get an alert before you notice. Maintenance is included in the monthly plan.
